ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; the visible surface is composed almost entirely of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with a ratio of high-intensity pixels near 0% across the main body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform distribution of low-intensity pixels across the visible fluke surface; absence of detectable high-contrast mottling, spots, or light-colored geometric patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, V-shaped central depression with an obtuse internal angle approximately 130-140 degrees; shallow indentation depth relative to the total fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge boundary; characterized by sharp pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys, with the most significant irregularities concentrated at the distal lobe terminals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave trajectory originating from the central bifurcation and extending to the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, high-contrast irregular pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced morphological irregularities and high-contrast encrustations visible at the far lateral margins of both lobes.
